meta.title: Central Vietnam Travel Guide: 6-Day Itinerary for Da Nang, Hoi An & Hue
meta.description:
Explore Central Vietnam in 6 days as we journey through Da Nang, Hoi An, and Hue.

From the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An and the scenic Marble Mountains in Da Nang to the historic Imperial City of Hue, this trip is packed with culture, history, and unforgettable food experiences.

Along the way, we tried some of the region’s most iconic dishes, including Cao Lầu, Bánh Mì, Bánh Xèo, Bánh Canh, and Bún Bò Huế—each offering a unique taste of Central Vietnam’s rich culinary heritage.

👉 For the full travel blog with detailed itinerary, tips, and restaurant addresses: https://travelwithlens.com/da-nang-hoi-an-hue-itinerary/
